lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to confront the city of bloodshed, guilty of shed blood and defiled by the idols she made.
The foreign resident is exploited, the fatherless and the widow are oppressed, and people take bribes to shed blood.
God says He will scatter the people among the nations, and then they will know that her idols are strong.
Because Israel has become dross, God will gather them into Babylon and melt them with the fire of His wrath.
God searched for a man to stand in the gap but found no one, so He poured out His indignation.
